Union Palm Card

Palm Cards are the workhorse of grassroots outreach. Compact, easy to carry and built for face-to-face moments. Slip a stack in your pocket, bag or clipboard and you're ready for canvassing, tabling, events or handshake-and-go conversations. Perfect for campaign walk pieces, event promos, business intros, labor organizations, nonprofit outreach or quick-reference.

These Palm Cards feature an official union bug, indicating they came off the press at a union print shop. From the folks who set the ink to the ones who packed the box, these pieces were made by workers covered by a collective bargaining agreement.

The Union Palm Card is our standard palm card produced at a union print shop, carrying the official union bug that shows it came off the press under a collective bargaining agreement. Political campaigns and labor organizations order this version specifically when a labor endorsement, party rule, or contract requires union-printed materials.

Specifications

Sizes4 x 9 (inches)
Minimum Quantity1000
Quantity Breaks1000, 2500, 5000, 10000
Turnaround5–7 business days from proof approval

Common Use Cases

  • Political campaign walk pieces requiring a union label
  • Labor organization canvassing and member outreach
  • Campaigns holding or pursuing a labor endorsement
  • Tabling and event handouts for union-affiliated organizations

How to Order

  1. 1 Confirm the 4 x 9 union-printed format in the configurator above
  2. 2 Select design services if you need them, then choose your quantity
  3. 3 Review your total price — it updates automatically as you select options
  4. 4 Click Buy Now to check out securely, or Request a Quote if you'd like to talk it through with us first

Frequently Asked Questions

What does the union bug mean on this palm card?

The union bug indicates the piece was printed at a union shop under a collective bargaining agreement, from the press operators to the packing crew. It's commonly required for materials tied to a labor endorsement.

What size is the Union Palm Card available in?

This product is offered in a single 4 x 9 union-printed format.

Can I get design help for my union palm card?

Yes, design services are available as an add-on during checkout.

Is there a non-union version of this palm card?

Yes — see our standard Palm Card, which offers more size and stock options for campaigns that don't require a union label.

What's the minimum order?

1,000 pieces, with breaks at 2,500, 5,000, and 10,000.
